Scroll down on the page and verify success

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { PageAction, createEngine, interact } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { browser: { mode: "always" } };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await interact(engine, url, [{ amount: 500, direction: "down", kind: "scroll" } as PageAction]);
  console.log(result.actionResults[0].success);
  console.log(result.actionResults[0].actionType);
  console.log(result.actionResults[0].actionIndex);
}

void main();
```
